caption:
The collection plan does not pause between incidents. Standing tasking runs across the area of interest on a fixed revisit cycle, day and night, whether or not anything is happening on the ground.

Most of that tasking produces nothing worth escalating. That is by design, not a shortfall — the value is in catching the pass that does. Every cycle gets reviewed, logged, and closed out, incident or no incident.

The volume that runs quietly is what makes the rare escalation credible. A system that only looks when something is already wrong isn't a collection plan. It's a reaction.
